title: A multicenter examination and strategic revisions of the Yale Global Tic Severity Scale
evidence_type: peer-reviewed cross-sectional psychometric study and expert-consensus proposed revisions
review_scope: Historical study selected by October25 next-question plan, not new evidence in current publication window
population: Seven US academic tic/OCD specialty clinics, ages5–69; DSM-IV tic disorders, primarily Tourette; mixed clinical-care/trial ascertainment
comparator: Descriptive adult/youth comparisons, then pooled internal consistency and item-score distributions
intervention: None tested in this psychometric analysis; source cohorts include clinical trials
outcomes: Original clinician-rated YGTSS 7–10-day motor/phonic total tic severity and separate tic-related impairment; revisions proposed after original-scale analysis

results.note: Alpha is internal consistency, not interrater reliability or subgroup measurement invariance. Adult/youth total tic and impairment contrasts not marked significant; no equivalence established.

negative_and_conflicting_evidence: Cross-site/rater interrater and test–retest reliability not examined despite training
No ASD/communication-specific validation identified in inspected main report; missing subgroup counts are not zero
Revised form recommended by consensus, not prospectively validated or head-to-head tested here
Discussion alpha range differs from explicit motor table/abstract value; table retained
Text-extracted Table3 signs differ from direction labels in two cells; visual confirmation unavailable and cells not used in analysis
follow_up: Cross-sectional; no developmental trajectory or durability inference
uncertainty: No subgroup-specific precision or measurement equivalence established; no new coefficients/intervals reconstructed
attrition_missingness: Reported617 total for main tables; source-protocol selection and item-level missingness beyond published report not independently reconstructed
adverse_events: Not an intervention safety analysis; no absence-of-risk inference
risk_of_bias: No reported ASD/language stratified validity assessment
funding_conflicts: NIH and charitable/research funding; author disclosures include royalties and industry relationships; not conflict-free certification
related_cohorts: Includes data from cited pediatric/adult CBIT and other clinical studies; do not count psychometric report as independent treatment replication
claim_supported: Broader pooled original-scale internal consistency and rationale for proposed anchor revisions
claim_not_supported: Interchangeable tic severity and lived burden
retrieval_status: Lawful UC repository PDF text and indexed primary excerpts inspected; screenshots failed; direct PMC challenged and EuropePMC XML500. Supplements/source-trial exclusions not audited. No paper copy retained.
correction_retraction_check: PubMed EFetch returned no CommentsCorrections; bounded exact DOI notice search found none, not exhaustive clearance
reviewer: AI-assisted methods extraction with independent source/arithmetic review, not clinical peer review
next_verification_task: Inspect2021 EMTICS original psychometrics (PMID33716826) factorial/convergent/discriminant methods and negative findings, keeping pediatric applicability distinct from unanswered adult/ASD validity.
